county-officials.summary: Your county board district is named, but not the supervisor who holds it — the card links your county's board instead.
county-officials.why: Wisconsin publishes every county's board district lines in one statewide file, but no statewide roster of the supervisors in them. Only each county publishes its own members, 72 different ways, so no name is shown rather than a guessed one.
county-officials.wanted: A county's own board page that lists each supervisory district beside the supervisor holding it — one county is enough to start, and 23 counties already publish exactly that.
